files.title: File:Astoria Riverfront Trolley on trestle west of 2nd Street-crop.jpg
files.author: Steve Morgan
files.caption: Astoria Riverfront Trolley car 300 westbound on a trestle over a minor inlet of the Columbia River.  This heritage streetcar line in Astoria, Oregon, has been in operation since 1999. Car 300 is an ex-San Antonio (Texas) streetcar built in 1913 by the American Car Company, by that time a subsidiary of the J. G. Brill Company.
